castle_open_day.label: Open the little castle
castle_open_day.note: Uncoil the air supply, seal the valve, flatten the landing, release the mesh and finally start the blower.

castle_close_night.label: Last bounce, lights out
castle_close_night.note: Stop the fan, lower and buckle the mesh, then bring the pennant down for the night.

castle_rain_cover.label: Button up for rain
castle_rain_cover.note: Stop the blower before closing the doorway and rolling the apron out of the rain.

castle_after_rain.label: Shake yesterday out
castle_after_rain.note: Drain stored roof water, shake droplets from the mesh and sweep real tracks from the landing.

castle_winter_layup.label: Put the castle to bed
castle_winter_layup.note: Coil the stopped blower hose, vent the chamber, loosen both ropes and fold the apron. This leaves the house closed for play.

castle_spring_retension.label: Wake the guy ropes
castle_spring_retension.note: Lay out the hose, tighten both sides separately, and inspect the seam without pretending to repair it.

castle_dust_service.label: Give the blower a breather
castle_dust_service.note: Switch off before sweeping the grille, straighten the air supply, restart and read the actual pressure.

castle_guest_welcome.label: Make an entrance
castle_guest_welcome.note: Sweep the landing, unbuckle and roll the mesh, then hoist the welcome pennant.

castle_pressure_check.label: Follow the escaping air
castle_pressure_check.note: Compare pressure before and after sealing the valve and straightening the hose. A reading is not a repair.

castle_evening_air.label: Let the fabric breathe
castle_evening_air.note: Stop the blower, shake the wet mesh, open the valve and leave the apron flat to dry. No invented puddle is removed.
